title: TRASHLIGHT / MICRO SALVAGE LAMP
core_formula: real trash -> simple assembly -> light intervention -> small collectible lamp
core_lesson: DON'T UPGRADE THE MATERIAL - REASSIGN ITS ROLE.
summary: An empty cigarette pack, capped screw, plastic cup, bottle cap and foil are reassigned into a small lamp without hiding their low-status origins.
learn: Low-status waste can become collectible through role reassignment.
Simplicity can be strong when form, function and origin are readable.
